method: Segment data from the company's Q1 FY27 media release (ril.com). Q2 FY27 (filed 30 Oct 2026) was not yet retrievable in the snapshot; live mode parses the filing.

mr_q1fy27.title: Q1 FY27 media release — financial & operational performance

pr_q2fy27.title: Q2 FY27 press release (BSE filing, 30 Oct 2026)

business.summary: Conglomerate across oil-to-chemicals (O2C), digital services (Jio Platforms), retail and upstream oil & gas. In Q1 FY27, O2C was ~59% of segment revenue but Jio was the largest EBITDA contributor.
business.segmentsBasis: Segment revenue, Q1 FY27 (₹ cr). EBITDA shown alongside.

evidence.claim: Consolidated EBITDA ₹54,067 cr in Q1 FY27, +10.1% YoY; EBITDA margin 15.9% vs 18.0% a year earlier (−210 bps).

guidanceNote: No explicit numerical guidance on revenue, margins or capex was found in the retrieved disclosures. FINN does not infer guidance from tone.

commentary.text: Press-release title claims record quarterly PAT of ₹29,550 cr and completion of the Jio Platforms IPO (28 Oct 2026). Not yet reconciled to the results statement in the snapshot.
